slides.title: What This Repository Delivers
slides.subtitle: CLI tools for USD inspection and SimReady recommendations
body: General USD inspection plus knowledge_candidate generation for review and grouping
Static furniture SimReady recommendation, collider authoring, and optional runtime smoke tests
Unified usd_simready_cli.py process path for scale, orientation, collisions, and reports
Semantic metadata extraction (qcodes, classes, hierarchies, label_tags) for richer furniture signals

right: apply_static_furniture_simready.py writes authored USD or USDA
